judgments.rationale: Passage F004 specifies that the fourth prerequisite is giving the debtor 'an opportunity to make a written agreement with the head of the agency to repay the amount of the claim'. The source does not require that a written agreement actually be executed by the debtor before offset can proceed. By conditioning administrative offset on the debtor's execution of an agreement rather than the provision of an opportunity to make one, P0001 introduces an unauthorized requirement unsupported by the text.

Passages F000 through F004 establish that the agency head's authority to collect by administrative offset is conditioned on providing the debtor with written notice, an opportunity to inspect records, an opportunity for review within the agency, and an opportunity to make a written repayment agreement. P0000 accurately reflects all four statutory prerequisites and faithfully preserves the rule of F004 that the agency must afford the debtor the opportunity to reach an agreement rather than conditioning offset on the execution of one.
